newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet barge premiums steady, cargoes pressured.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet barge premiums steady, cargoes pressured.

text.p: NWE jet fuel barge premiums were steady on Friday, but cargo diffs came notionally under pressure with material headed into the region from the Caribbean.
Barges traded at Dec IPE +$31 fob Antwerp and Dec IPE +$32.25 fob Rotterdam.
Cargo buyers were relaxed by an open transatlantic arbitrage. A cargo was fixed for Nov 7 to head to Europe from the Caribbean.
Dec gas oil futures climbed $1.25 to close at $211 a tonne.
